Select the goals for all six robots in a single goal-assignment decision. You make the complete assignment yourself in one response.

Goal columns in order: A, B, C, D, E, F

A: 2, 6, 6, 9, 10, 6
B: 4, 6, 6, 7, 8, 4
C: 10, 2, 4, 3, 2, 6
D: 19, 11, 13, 8, 7, 11
E: 13, 7, 7, 8, 7, 11
F: 11, 7, 5, 8, 7, 9

If any goal is duplicated, any choice is invalid, or any robot's cost increases, the entire proposed reassignment is rejected and all robots keep their initial goals. A valid reassignment executes together. A robot that changes goals must strictly reduce its own cost; a robot that keeps its goal has unchanged cost. At least one robot must improve for a successful exchange. Your task is to choose all six goals to form such a mutually beneficial exchange. Staying with your initial goal is allowed. Robot paths visualize assignment costs only; collisions and travel timing are not part of this game.

Return exactly one JSON object containing only "goals": an array of six goal letters, in robot order A, B, C, D, E, F. For example {"goals":["A","B","C","D","E","F"]}. Allowed goal values: A, B, C, D, E, F. Do not include explanatory text.
